history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young person with dark hair, wearing a light grey hooded jacket with a black zipper and black wide-leg pants, stands in what appears to be an outdoor, slightly dilapidated area at night. The person is looking down and has their right hand raised to their head. The background features a brick wall, a weathered building with a tiled roof and a window covered by a wire mesh, and some overgrown vines. To the right, there's a teal metal chair and two grey plastic stools. The ground is paved with interlocking bricks. The lighting is dim and atmospheric, with a single visible light source casting a soft glow. The overall color palette is dominated by dark tones, with pops of grey, teal, and the muted colors of the building and foliage. The mood is somewhat moody and casual, with a hint of urban decay. The image has a slight grainy texture, suggesting it might have been taken with a phone camera in low light. The style is candid and observational, capturing a moment in time.
